_source: Corpos de erro reais observados na sonda de leitura de 2026-10-08 (scripts/probes/out, gitignored). Ids e traceIds substituídos por valores sintéticos; texto das mensagens mantido como veio da API.

cases.label: 403 corpo vazio (chave de dados em rota fiscal)
string JSON crua (companies v1)
cases.body: "pageIndex must be greater or equal to 1"
cases.expect_message: pageIndex must be greater or equal to 1

cases.label: string JSON crua (cancellation-xml)
cases.body: "Cancellation event XML not available for this service invoice (National environment only; legacy providers have no cancellation event XML, or the invoice has not been cancelled)."

cases.label: errors sem code (CNPJ)
cases.body: {"errors":[{"message":"cnpj is null, white space or not valid"}]}
cases.expect_message: cnpj is null, white space or not valid

cases.label: errors 40001 (CEP)
cases.expect_message: postalCode with value '00000000' is not valid

cases.label: ProblemDetails de validação
cases.body: {"type":"https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc9110#section-15.5.1","title":"One or more validation errors occurred.","status":400,"errors":{"pageIndex":["The value 'abc' is not valid."]},"traceId":"00-11111111111111111111111111111111-2222222222222222-01"}
cases.expect_message_contains: pageIndex: The value 'abc' is not valid.

cases.label: string de nota inexistente
cases.body: "service invoice with id (000000000000000000000000) was not found"
cases.expect_message: service invoice with id (000000000000000000000000) was not found

cases.label: ProblemDetails 500 do upload
cases.body: {"title":"An error occurred while processing your request.","status":500}
cases.expect_message: An error occurred while processing your request.
